project.name: Vendored jstl:jstl-jakarta:1.2
project.description:
Installs the checked-in binary of jstl:jstl-jakarta:1.2 into the local repository so the build no longer needs the external_free remote repository (https://aonsolutions.github.io/aon-application/maven/2/external_free), which is gone.
The jar and the pom next to this file are the artifacts that repository served, byte for byte -- they are NOT rebuilt here (two of the vendored jars are signed and several carry no manifest, so repackaging them would change what the application loads at runtime).
Listed at the top of the reactor: these are plain third-party coordinates, not reactor artifacts, so Maven cannot order them automatically. A single "clean install" over the whole reactor installs them before any module that consumes them is built.
